text: {"components": [{"type": "entity", "quote": "Galliker Transport AG", "gist": "Galliker Transport AG"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Fent AG from Seon (AG)", "gist": "Fent AG"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Thomas Lüem Partner AG from Baar (ZG)", "gist": "Thomas Lüem Partner AG"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "CKW AG from Lucerne", "gist": "CKW AG"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "“Buildings and spatial development” category", "gist": "Project category is 'Buildings and spatial development'"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Micro-district networks: Sharing heat intelligently with neighbours.", "gist": "Project involves micro-district networks for intelligent heat sharing with neighbours"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Today, it is possible to share electricity from a rooftop photovoltaic system with neighbours for collective self-consumption.", "gist": "Electricity from rooftop PV can now be shared with neighbours for collective self-consumption"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "However, the same principle makes sense for heating, because many home heating systems are oversized and therefore not used to full capacity.", "gist": "Heat sharing is also viable because many home heating systems are oversized and underutilized"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "By sharing the heat from your own heating system with neighbours, you can save on maintenance and heating costs.", "gist": "Sharing home heating system heat with neighbours reduces maintenance and heating costs"}]}
